reason: I only take gummies or drinks, I really don't do pills, and this is 2 capsules every night. The lab report is nice, but I'd just skip it and the box would sit in a drawer.
objection: It's capsules, 2 a day. And why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I don't know why bisglycinate alone is better.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or powder/drink version with the same lab-tested dose, or a plain explanation of why one form beats a blend.
